founderNoteBody:
Muli shani, niine Levi. Natampile ukupanga WitnessWork mu 2023 pa kupwisha amafya ayo nakwete nine umwine ilyo nale piyona. Icatampile fye nge cilangililo icapwe kunchitilwe nge cibombelo capalama capalama, capangilwe pa lwa ushiku ushingi no kushinguluka.

Calimoneka ukukoselesha ukumfwa kuli bamunyinefwe ne bankashi ukufuma mu calo conse abalemonako amaka. Insambililo yandi ya kuti ici cibombelo cikabombesha bwino kuli imwe pa myaka iingi iileisa.

No lutemwo lwa cibumba,

1382.c16: foni incende code nomba persists ukupula icipya abantu ba kutandalila. foni incende fwaya ni faster na na fimbi cacine.
1382.c17: mapu mwapolamo state, uko muli prompts, na uwa kutandalila mapu clustering have fyonse ba polished.
1382.c18: Countless cinono ubupusano fixes, performance improvements, na visual ukulungika throughout cibombelo.

1383.c1: Plans now have a Type. Assign a category to a scheduled plan and your projected totals reflect the right kind of credit.
1383.c2: Projected totals are more accurate. They respect your monthly credit cap and no longer double-count time you've already logged today.
1383.c3: The celebration chime now respects your ring/silent switch.
1383.c4: Your Donations now shows the correct billing period and price for annual and granted supporter subscriptions.
1383.c5: New contacts and address edits now save immediately, even before the map finishes locating them.
1383.c6: The calendar refreshes right away after you add, edit, or remove a plan.
1383.c7: Map pins stay in focus after you tap them.
1383.c8: Smoother scrolling in the Contacts list.

1400.c1: Switching from MyTime? You can now import your contacts and visit history straight from a MyTime backup, with a preview before anything is added, so there's no manual re-entry.
1400.c2: Date format, clock style, and start of the week are now separate from your app language. Set each one in Settings > Date & Time, with an Auto option that follows your region or device.
1400.c3: You can now customize the day thresholds and colors behind contact staleness. Tune them in Settings > Personalization > Color Key.
1400.c4: The map search box keeps focus while you type, so filtering contacts no longer interrupts you.
1400.c5: Locating contacts on the map now shows live progress, and you can skip it midway without losing your place.
1400.c6: Faster, smoother scrolling in the Contacts list, plus quicker home screen widget updates.
1400.c7: Fixed projected totals around time zone changes, enlarged header buttons for easier tapping, and polished countless small details throughout the app.

1411.c1: Icipya: Kumanya Scribe AI. Namikeni ifyebo fyenu fya mulimo wa kushimikila, nangu ifyalembwa ku kuboko nangu ifyafuma mu app imbi, na Scribe AI ikafyalula ku bantu ba kulanshanya na bo, ukutandalila, ne nshita mwabombela pa kuti mubebete ilyo tacisungwa. Kuti mwawamya ifyafumamo mu kulanshanya, kuti mwatampa ukuleta ifyebo ukufuma na pa kutampa app, kabili tamwakalufye credit pa kuleta ifyebo ifyabula ifyasangwa.
1411.c2: Dashboard ipya ya 'Uno Mweshi' pa cilangililo ca ntanshi iyo kuti mwacinja. Ico mwapanga ukufikapo, ifyo cimoneka, no kubutuka kwa bupange fyaba mu makadi ayo kuti mwatantika no kukusha, ilyo Lipoti yenu ya mulimo ikala mu kadi imo iyayanguka. Tinikeni lipoti pa kumona fyonse mu bwipi.
1411.c3: ico mwapanga ukufikapo cila mweshi overrides. bika calekana ico mwapanga ukufikapo pa lwa single mweshi ilyo yenu circumstances cinja, na mona yenu fyapangilwe ama-awala nga yabo own ukwenda pantanshi ring.
1411.c4: ubupange na fimbi than cimo thing pa bushiku. bushiku ubupange pa cimo cine ubushiku nomba lundapo together, cila keeping ya ici own ulupange, na ubupange ico cita te penda ukulo bushiku ni clearly marked.
1411.c5: Easier ukulungika everywhere. ubupange, ifyalembwa fya nshita, na ukulanshanya nomba have ellipsis menu pa lwa lungika na fumyapo, na ubupange ububwekeshapo offer fumyapo choices pa lwa changing cimo ubushiku, kuntanshi inshiku, nelyo whole series.
1411.c6: Malipoti ya mulimo: Ukutuma kwa Hourglass na NW Publisher nabwela, kuti mwasala inshila ya kutuma iya lyonse, kuti mwalungika amashiwi ya lipoti ilyo tamwatuma, kabili mukapoka icakukumbushanya pa mpela ya mweshi. Ifyacitika fya myaka na myaka nomba kuti mwafyicefya nelyo mwalundapo imyaka ya kunuma.
1411.c7: ubupange nomba shows cila day's status pa glance: kuntanshi, kunuma, muli munshila bwino, cileisa, matched, nelyo no ubupange.
1411.c8: Ukuba Uwafwilisha nomba kulakonka Apple ID yenu pa fibombelo fyonse, ifya Scribe AI filabweshiwapo ukulingana ne nshita, kabili icilangililo ca Uwafwilisha calyanguka.
1411.c9: Fixed ifyalembwa fya nshita na ubupange landing pa icilubo bushiku mu inshita zones pa UTC+12 na beyond, lunda icilubo-bushiku inshiku late mu evening west wa UTC. Fixed mapu pins opening icilubo uwa kutandalila panuma swiping card carousel. inshita ukusenda inshita nomba keeps inshita ya kwishibilwa mu ya ici ica cine mweshi na ica cifyalilwa.
1411.c10: Icakwalula ca Credit pa malupange nomba cilipo kuli bonse ababomfya amaawala. Twawamya ubwafya bunono ubwaleleta ukwima ilyo mwafunga icakusala, twabwesha intanda sha fyatemwikwa ne cishibilo ca sambililo lya Baibolo lya uno mweshi, twacinja ku Expo SDK 57, kabili twacefya ubukulu bwa app.

1420.c1: Imipekanishishe ipya iya pa iPad ilanga abantu, amapu na mapange mu mbali ya fiputulwa fyafyo.
1420.c2: Pekanyeni ififulo fya mashina ya bantu: aluleni ukulondana kwa namba ya foni, imeyili na fifulo ifyo mwalenga, fiseni namba ya foni nangu imeyili, kabili futilenipo ififulo ifyo mwalenga ifyabikwa mu busungilo.
1420.c3: Moneni inshita mwalemba ukulingana ne fiputulwa mu mwaka onse wa mulimo, kabili aluleni umupaka wa maawala ya milimo imbi ayapendwa ku mweshi mu fyakusala fya mitundu ya babila imbila nsuma ayasuminisha ifi.
1420.c4: Amalipoti ayatumwa ku Hourglass nomba yalekanya inshita ya kubila imbila nsuma ku maawala ya milimo imbi ayapendwa.
1420.c5: Umwafwilisha wa kalendala nomba alipo na kabili, ne fya kumupekanishisha mu fyakusala fya Mapange.

1430.c1: Inshila ya kucingilila ifyebo iya bakabilisha mu EU, mu UK na mu Switzerland isunga ifyebo fya bene ba ng'anda ukulingana ne fyo ifunde lisuminisha, pamo no kulemba ukusumina kwabo no kufumyapo abantu ba kutandalila abo mushatandalilepo inshita ntali.
1430.c2: Lundapo uwa kutandalila ukufuma pa cishibilo mwabika pa mapu.
1430.c3: Bakabilisha ba Bufumu kuti basala ukulemba amaawala yabo ne cakupimako inshita, ico bapanga ukufikapo mu mweshi (te ca kukakatila) ne cipande ca Ukukula.
1430.c4: Icipande ca Year nomba cilalanga amaawala yonse aya mwaka wa mulimo ku bakabilisha ba misango yonse, nangu tapali ico mwapanga ukufikapo mu mwaka.
1430.c5: Ukupanga ukubwekeshapo pa ntandalilo nomba te ca kukakatila, kabili kuti mwashimya ifyunda fya app mu Preferences.
1430.c6: Twawamya inshiku ishalealuka ku bakabilisha abaikala mu fifulo fya nshita ifya ku kabanga ka kutali.

1440.c1: Ukwenda kwangu na fipao fine fyakwata amashina ifyo kuti mwaluputula. Mapu nomba yaba pa mulu wa Abantu ba Kulanshanya, kabili Settings fili pe shina lya cikope cenu.
1440.c2: Abantu ba Kulanshanya bapangwa bupya pa ifyakonkapo, kabili ulutandalilo lonse lukwata ubushiku bwalo pa mulongo. Lembeni ulutandalilo ukufuma pa menyu ya +, ne fisonto ifya pafupi, no kulundako ifyabula pa kulanshanya.
1440.c3: Ukupanga kwakwata kalenda ya mwaka ne ya mweshi iyo mwingakusha, kabili ubupange kuti bwaba amaawala fye nelyo inshita ya kutendeka no kupwa.
1440.c4: Moneni ifyo mulekula mu mwaka wa mulimo umweshi ku mweshi, kabili mwisekelele ukukonkana ne baji pa nshila.
1440.c5: Ukukonkelela amakilomita, nga mulefwaya, kulemba amalwendo yenu ne mutengo wa mafuta.
1440.c6: Ukukonkapo kuti kwalunganikanya ku kalenda ya WitnessWork fye, nomba na pa Android, uko kuti mwasunga no kulunganikanya na Google Drive.
1440.c7: Ukukumbusha kulemupembela mu mulandu wa ifyakwishibisha mu cifulo ca kubunganina pa Pa Ntanshi.

iCloudImagesEnableConfirm_description:
Icikope cenu ca profile ne fikope fyonse fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyo mwalundako fikakopololwa ku iCloud Drive yenu. Fikalunganikanya ku fibombelo fyenu ifimbi kabili fikapendwa mu cifulo cenu ica iCloud. Ifikope fya profile ne fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyaputulwa e fyatumwa; ifya cine ifyashaputulwa fisala pa cibombelo uko mwafisalila.

Pa kucingilila bwino sana, tulemusuminisha ukuwasha Advanced Data Protection ya iCloud (Settings → [Ishina Lyenu] → iCloud → Advanced Data Protection) pa kuti ifikope fyacingililwe ukufuma ku ntendekelo ukufika ku mpela, kabili ifibombelo fyenu fye fikwata ifisokoshi.

Ifikope fya profile ne fya bantu ba kulanshanya ifyaputulwa e fyatumwa; ifya cine ifyashaputulwa fisala pa cibombelo uko mwafisalila.
iCloudImagesDisableConfirm_description: Ukuleka kuleka ukutuma no kusenda pa cibombelo ici. Ifikope ifyatumwa ne fyo fili pa cibombelo fisala apo fili. Pa kufumyapo na fikope ifyatumwa, pa ntanshi lekeni ukulunganikanya ifikope pa fibombelo fyenu ifimbi pa kuti tafitume nakabili ifya cene.

serviceYearPace.info: Umulongo wa kasaka uwakata wa buwaya ulanga uko Ico Mwapanga ukufikapo mu Mwaka cimwikata pa mpela ya cila mweshi, upangwa ukufuma ku co mwapanga ica cila mweshi. Umulongo wa kasaka wa bulongwe ni nshita yenu ukufika lelo, panuma ya mupaka wa credit wa cila mweshi, kabili uwakata wa bulongwe ulundako ubupange bwenu. Umulongo uwasasamuka ni mwaka wa mulimo uwapita, ilyo mwalembamo inshita, ne ndambo yaco pa mpela. Ifyonse ifyapita sana co mwapanga fyalembwa mu cipimo cinono pa kuti umwaka onse ubelengwe bwino. Tinikeni no kukakatila pa ncati pa kumona umweshi uli onse.

dataProtectionDesc: Ilesuminishiwa mu EU, UK, na Switzerland.
dataProtectionInfoDesc: Ifilye mu EU fyalipingwile ukuti ifyo mulemba pa bantu mukumanya mu mulimo wa kushimikila fyaba mwi funde lya kucingilila ifyebo. Nga ici calibilishiwa, WitnessWork isunga ifyebo fya mwine wa ng'anda fye nga nasumina, ifisa ififulo fya fikope na fya uwaume/umwanakashi, imucenjeshe pa fifulo ifyo mwalenga ifyakwata ifyebo fya nkama, taisunga intandalilo sha abashali pa ng'anda, ifwaya adiresi pa cibombelo cenu fye, ishimya ukwakanya abantu ba kutandalila, kabili imweba ukufumyapo abantu ba kutandalila abo tamutandalilepo mu nshiku 90. Ukuleta ifyebo ukufuma mu fyebo kucili kutuma amalembo mwalemba ku AI ya kampani imbi pa kuti ifipekanye, lelo tatuma abantu ba kutandalila abo mwakwata kale. Nga mwabilisha iCloud sync, ifyebo fyenu fisungwa mu iCloud kabili filingana pa fibombelo fyenu fyonse. Ici te kufunda kwa mafunde — konkeni ifyo ofeshi ya musambo ilanda.
dataProtectionInfoDescAndroid: Amabwalo mu EU yatonda ukuti amalembo pa bantu abo mwakumana nabo mu mulimo wa kushimikila yaba mu funde lya kucingilila ifyebo. Ilyo iyi yawashiwa, WitnessWork isunga fye ifyebo fya mwine ng'anda panuma ya kusumina, ifisa ifipande fya fikope na bwanakashi/bwaume, ilekebuka pa fipande fya cila muntu ifya kucenjesha, tayalemba ukutandalila ukwa taali pa ng'anda, isunga ukufwaya adiresi pa cibombelo cenu, ishimya ukusabankanya abantu ba kulanshanya, kabili ipela ukufumyapo abantu ba kulanshanya abo mwatatandalile mu nshiku 90. Ici te lulayo lwa mu funde — konkeni ifyo Ofesi ya Musambo yenu ilanda. Ukuleta Amalembo kucili kutumina amalembo ayo mwabika ku service ya AI iya kuli bambi pa kuyapwisha, lelo tayatumina lyashi lyenu lya bantu ba kulanshanya. Nga mwawasha Google Drive sync, ifyalembwa fyenu fisungwa muli Google Drive yenu no kulunganikanya pa fibombelo fyenu.

badges_infoBody: Amabaji yapenda imyeshi, te maawala, ico bonse bakula pa lupwa lumo. Ilyo mwapokelela baji, isala yenu.
badges_showSetting_info: Ilanga amabaji yenu pa profile yenu no kusekelela ayapya. Ukushimya ici kuyafisa; tapali cintu mwapokelela icilufya.
streaks_showSetting_info: Ilanga ukukonkana kwenu pa Pa Ntanshi na pa profile yenu, ilakusekelela, kabili ilamukumbusha ukushilapwa. Ukushimya ici kufisa ukukonkana kwenu ne kwa banyina benu, kabili kwisa leka ukusabankanya ukwenu.
buddies_badgeAlertsInfo: Ifyakwishibisha ilyo munyina apokelela baji ipya nelyo asuka ku baji yenu. Fyonse fibili fimoneka mu fyakwishibisha fyenu.
updateReveal_badges_caption: Sekeleleni imyeshi iyakonkana, te maawala. Yasabankanyeni na banyina.
updateReveal_badges_captionNoBuddies: Sekeleleni imyeshi iyakonkana, te maawala. Yasangeni pa profile yenu.
onboardingBuddies_nameHint: Lundeni ishina lyenu pa kuti munyina wenu ashibe uwamwita.
onboardingBuddies_description: Tantikeni ne bantu ukufika pa batanu aba mwingaya nabo mu mulimo. Moneni inshiku ne nshita shapangwa ishabo pa kalenda yenu, mubaite ku Bupange nelyo Ukukonkapo, nelyo mupempe ukuiba pa bwabo.
onboardingBuddies_private: Cingililwa ukufuma ku ntendekelo ukufika ku mpela. Amaawala yenu ne malipoti fisala fya cinkama.
onboardingBuddies_private_info: Banyina bamona ishina lyenu, icikope (nga mwacisala), umusango wa painiya, ne nshiku ne nshita mupanga ukuya mu mulimo. Amaawala yenu, amalipoti, ico mwapanga, abantu ba kulanshanya, na malembo fisala fya cinkama. Ukwita munyina ku Bupange nelyo Ukukonkapo kutuma ifyebo ifilangwa muli ko. Tapali icasabankanishiwa ukufika mwe bonse mwashininkisha, kabili imwe fye na banyina benu mwingabelenga.
onboardingBuddies_later: Itaneni banyina inshita iili yonse ukufuma pa **Ukupanga → Buddies**.
onboardingBuddies_invited: Ukwita kwatumwa. Ilyo munyina asumina, mumushininkishe pa **Ukupanga → Buddies**.
